title: Process-global sync.Map keyed by pool, and a tracker that learns only from failures
notes: db.Of(pool) looks the tracker up in a package-level sync.Map that Open fills and nothing removes. Every caller that was handed some other pool (tests, tools) silently gets a nil tracker that never says 'away'. Holding the tracker on a small wrapper type or in Server/Jobs/Worker fields would cost a few constructor changes and would make the missing-tracker case a compile error, not a silent no-op. Closed at the pivot: Rule 17: says nothing a viewer or operator would notice (a test's strength, a refactor, tooling or an internal cost). Reopen with the effect someone sees and its evidence.
